name: [PUBLIC TEST!] Vampire life
desc:
Become stronger with every passing year.

You may begin your journey as a Human or awaken as a Natural-Born Vampire. Humans can still be turned later, but Natural Vampires possess greater potential and power.

As you level up, your strength, abilities, and chances of becoming an Original increase — placing you among the most powerful vampires in the game.

Grow older. Gain power. Hunt your enemies. Feed. Survive.
Rise through the ranks, unlock deadly abilities, and carve your name into the darkness.
Will you remain human... or become the monster everyone fears?
